exact_infinite_order.limitation: Infinite order does NOT imply dense PU(3), full single-qutrit Clifford group, a universal multiqudit gate set, or physical photonic implementation.
exact_infinite_order.proof: If A has finite projective order, A^n=scalar I. Since det(A)=-i is a root of unity, scalar is a root of unity, so all eigenvalues of A are roots of unity. Its trace would then be an algebraic integer. But trace=-1/sqrt(3) has field norm -1/3 in Q(sqrt(3)), impossible for an algebraic integer. Thus A has infinite projective order.
exact_infinite_order.published_context: Qutrit metaplectic reflection R=diag(1,1,-1) and Clifford+R are established prior art; this exact embedding is a project-specific repackaging.
